# CANDIDATE: VIX_COMPRESSION_GAMMA_SQUEEZE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Low VIX (<12) combined with ATR contraction (<0.5% of price) indicates suppressed expected volatility; a break above resistance with above-average volume can trigger a dealer‑gamma squeeze, offering a long edge in SPY calls.

## Mechanism

Entry: When VIX < 12, ATR(14) < 0.005×close, and price closes above a named resistance level (prior day high, VWAP, or opening range high) with volume > average volume, enter long at the close of the breakout bar. Exit: Stop at the midpoint of the prior consolidation range (or at resistance turned support); TP1 at 2× ATR above entry; runner trail 10% off high‑water mark. Regime filter: only consider bars between 10:30‑14:30 ET and avoid days where price consistently trades below VWAP.
